starting_executable_finding.finding: 3s stale-task threshold caused real reclaim thrashing because healthy worker heartbeats stop during blocking decode; 12s avoided observed thrash but turns recovery speed into a decode-latency tuning tradeoff

additional_source_finding: The existing Fabric.runtime_heartbeat advances the global fabric epoch. A naive high-frequency background heartbeat would therefore create avoidable global CAS churn while trying to solve decode-time liveness.

implemented.purpose: dedicated runtime liveness heartbeat that refreshes nodes.last_seen_ts without advancing cognitive S1 epoch; daemon HeartbeatPump can continue while main node thread is blocked in decode
fail-closed tests for no epoch churn, freshness during simulated blocking decode, no false reclaim while pump is alive, real reclaim after pump stops, and missing-node rejection

authority_boundary: runtime membership metadata only; does not grant coordinator lease, does not write S1 scopes, does not mint S0 truth/effects, no provider/network/secret calls
next_exact_action: Repository-bound execute the new liveness tests on a clean non-provider checkout.
